description:
Adds many types of monster.

Prepare to face a variety of new monsters and enemies across your world, includes:

- Dirt Monster (3 variants)
- Dungeon Master (4 variants)
- Fire Spirit (1 variant)
- Land Guard (8 variants)
- Lava Flan (3 variants)
- Oerkki (4 variants)
- Sand Monster (2 variants)
- Spider (6 variants)
- Stone Monster (4 variants)
- Tree Monster (6 variants)
